children: U.S. current account balance stood at -$246.0B, compared with the -$252.5B consensus and -$212.6B for Q1 2026 (revised from -$226.8B), according to data released by the Bureau of Economic Analysis on Thursday.
The 15.7% increase in deficit reflected an expanded deficit on goods that was partly offset by reduced deficits on primary (earned) income and on secondary income (current transfers).
Q2 deficit was 3.0% of current dollar gross domestic product, up from 2.7% in the first quarter.

Exports of goods and services to, and income received from, foreign residents increased $58.8B to $1.44 trillion in the second quarter, while imports of goods and services from, and income paid to, foreign residents increased $92.2B to $1.69 trillion.

title: Current account deficit widens less than expected in Q2
